newsitem.title: GERMANY: German industry output rebounds in June.
newsitem.headline: German industry output rebounds in June.

text.p: German industrial production rose by 1.4 percent in June from May after output figures for the previous month were revised sharply downwards to show a 1.5 percent fall, the Economics Ministry said on Monday.
The ministry said that the data, which were preliminary, were likely to be revised up substantially.
Leading the upturn in output in June were construction, where output rose by six percent, and consumer durables, with production up 5.2 percent, the data showed.

Output rose in western and eastern Germany more slowly than the national figure because of differences in statistical methodology. Production in western Germany rose by 0.4 percent in June, and by 0.5 percent in the east.
On a two-month basis, output in Germany was up by 0.9 percent in May and June compared to the same period a year earlier.
Over the first half of 1997, industrial production was 2.3 percent higher than a year earlier. In western Germany it was up by 1.8 percent and in the east by 3.9 percent.
